attested in source

  • CURIE: gmeow:attestedInSource
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedInSource
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/lexicon
  • Box roles: CBox role, RBox role (What is this?)

The bibliographic or documentary source in which the attested form was observed. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an attestation may be supported by multiple sources, and competing source attributions coexist (Principle 9). Targets a CreativeWork (the retired Source Kind was greenfield-refactored in source/claim refactor).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:UsageAttestation -> gmeow:CreativeWork

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:attestedInSource from gmeow:UsageAttestation to gmeow:CreativeWork when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:UsageAttestation, gmeow:CreativeWork

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use on a UsageAttestation to name the bibliographic or documentary source — a CreativeWork — in which the form was observed.

Avoid when

  • Avoid forcing a single source (it is non-functional; an attestation may cite several) and avoid naming the physical artifact here (that is gmeow:attestedOnCarrier) or the corpus/community context (gmeow:attestedInContext).

How to use

  • Point gmeow:attestedInSource at one or more gmeow:CreativeWork sources (required by the someValuesFrom axiom); competing source attributions coexist.

Examples

  • ex:att1 gmeow:attestedInSource ex:oed.
